types.description: List of unit types to query (e.g., service, timer, socket, mount). See --type=TYPE in systemctl(1). Items must be strings representing valid systemd unit types.

states.description: List of unit states to filter by (e.g., loaded, failed, active, inactive). See --state=STATE in systemctl(1). Items must be strings representing valid systemd unit states.

properties.description: List of unit property names to display. See --property=NAME in systemctl(1). Items must be strings.

all_units.description: If true, enables --all flag to show all loaded units/properties including dead/empty ones. See -a, --all in systemctl(1).

full_output.description: If true, enables --full flag to prevent ellipsizing unit names. See -l, --full in systemctl(1).

quiet_mode.description: If true, enables --quiet flag to suppress output. See -q, --quiet in systemctl(1).
